name: Onna Kishi o Tsukamaeta Buhi!
original_name: 女騎士を捕まえたブヒ!
source:
The female knight hunts low-ranking orcs.
One wallop from a giant orc knocks her unconscious...
She opens her eyes, in the roost of minions...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179431.html]DLsite English[/url]]
